note: SYNTHETIC PLACEHOLDER rubrics, built from the public P2E lesson lists (global.passport2earning.org, read 18 Nov 2026: Khan Academy Financial Literacy 101, Microsoft Business 101 Budgeting, How to get a Job, UNICEF Communication Skills). Educators: replace with approved rubrics (3-4 criteria, levels 1-4). Learners see the level descriptors in words, never a number. 'kind' tells lib/evidence.ts how to read an answer; 'keywords' are the course's own terms. Pidgin text needs native-speaker review.
